title: Moroccan Sausage Skillet
description: A hearty and flavorful skillet dish featuring moroccan seasoned sausages, tender bell peppers, and a sweet jammy sauce.
instructions: Heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the moroccan sausages and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausages and set aside.
Add the tender bell peppers to the skillet and cook until tender.
Return the sausages to the skillet.
In a small bowl, whisk together the amlou and jammy.
Pour the sauce over the sausages and bell peppers.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 400°F for 10-12 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
